text:
nina: Postmortem follow-up for the token validation outage 95 — thanks for the response last night. We need to lock owners, deadlines, and a short verification cadence so this doesn't drift.
eli: i'll take the validation fix + unit/e2e tests. creating jira INF-4899. target: Fri COB for PR + staging verification.
sam: i'll own audit side: extend raw auth trace retention and add anomaly alerts. plan: retention -> 90d, add alert for auth-failure-rate spike. PR by Thu. runbook snippet will go in /playbooks/authz/audit-retention.md
nina: can you paste the log query you'll use for the alert?
sam: sure: ```source=auth-service logs | where status=="FAIL" and validator=="jwt" | summarize count() by service, user``` 
eli: deployment strategy question 95 recommend canary + metric gates. propose 5% for 6h, if pass then 20% for 24h, then full. Gates: token-fail-rate <= baseline+0.5% and 5xx rate stable. add auto-rollback on gate breach.
nina: agree. include synthetic checks hitting token endpoints every 2m during canary. add a runbook step to check KV cache consistency.
sam: rotation note 95 scoped key rotation for token-verifier SA keys. i'll coordinate with infra to reserve rotation window Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. will add a pre/post validation step to confirm key access.
eli: i'll add test vectors and the minimal repro to INF-4899. also adding a non-regression test to the perf CI.
nina: ops-bot, can you create a 4-week recurring follow-up in #incidents for owners and post a weekly summary?
ops-bot: Recurring follow-up created: #incidents every Wed 11:00 for 4 occurrences. Weekly summary will be posted after each check-in. DM reminder 20m prior.
sam: also adding an audit pipeline integrity check: verify ingestion lag <5m and checksums for token trace batches. PR will include the alert playbook.
eli: small checklist before canary: - add e2e test - infra feature-flag - synthetic pings - rollback playbook - monitor dashboards. I'll post status in INF-4899.
nina: owners recap -> eli (validation fix + tests + INF-4899), sam (audit retention & alerts + runbook), infra (rotation window + KMS policy checks). Verification cadence -> weekly Wed 11:00 x4, escalate to #eng-oncall if canary fails.
ops-bot: All action items linked to INF-4899. Participants: nina, eli, sam. Reminders set.
eli: thanks everyone. i'll request a small canary slice in staging first and report results here. if anyone notices abnormal token rejection rate during canary, tag @nina immediately. :raised_hands:
